statement: OpenAI shipped GPT-6 Astra, continuing a rapid frontier-model release cadence from ChatGPT to o1 to Astra in four years.
why: Each frontier release resets the compute floor for training the next model and for serving inference on the new one, so release cadence is a leading indicator of accelerator demand.

impact.mechanism: A new frontier model launch drives both the next training cluster order and a step-up in inference serving capacity, feeding merchant-GPU demand.

evidence.excerpt: From ChatGPT to o1 to Astra in 4 years. AGI has arrived.

confidence.basis: Secondary coverage of a competitor CEO's social post; the document notes OpenAI itself has not characterised GPT-6 Astra as AGI and no primary launch document was read.

dispersion: The 'AGI has arrived' framing is Huang's characterisation only, not OpenAI's.
